entries.4decde98d3cbe449: The consolidated subsidiary Asahi Nichiso Plastic Products (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. performs molding of plastic products and design and manufacture of molds for resin molding in China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥3,851 million.
entries.6c76bf6124784569: A single business that molds plastic products and designs and manufactures molds for resin molding. The reportable segments, based on the production and sales structure by region, are three: "Japan," "China" and "Thailand," and in each region the company produces and sells power tool parts, automotive parts and other plastic products. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥3,595 million in Japan, ¥3,851 million in China and ¥912 million in Thailand. Sales consisted of ¥7,981 million in product sales and ¥378 million in mold sales.
